title: Rental Sales Tax on KestrelCare Rental Reimbursements
content:
| Registration state on the vehicle's purchase order | Rental sales tax rate |
|---|---|
| Arizona | 8.3 percent (0.083) |
| Texas | 10 percent (0.10) |
| any other state | none |

**Rule.** Rental sales tax is added to a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts rental reimbursement at the rate for the state in which the vehicle is registered on its Vehicle Purchase Agreements purchase order: the Arizona rental tax rate for Arizona, the Texas rental tax rate for Texas, and no rental sales tax for any other state.

The tax is added to the rental amount for the nights by multiplying that amount by one plus the rate.

*Hypothetical figures:* a rental amount of 200.00 becomes 216.60 for a vehicle registered in Arizona, 220.00 for one registered in Texas, and stays 200.00 for one registered in Georgia.
